title: 2026-11-05: Merging browser changes matters more; I keep losing the source

sections.name: narrative
sections.content:
I can live with this. the more important work however is merging in changes that are in the browser. 
I keep loosing the source, then needing to save to disk, and then have to find a way to merge back in again.
